report.summary: The drop is almost entirely on iOS. It starts right after the iOS 5.14.0 release, which changed the payment sheet. An open bug report and support tickets describe the same failure.

causes.title: iOS 5.14.0 broke the payment sheet for saved cards

claims.text: Checkout conversion fell 12% against its 28 day baseline on 2025-10-03.
iOS accounts for 88% of the drop. Android and web are flat.
iOS 5.14.0 shipped a new payment sheet at 09:10 UTC, and the iOS payment sheet error rate rose from 0.4% to 11.7% in the same hour.
claims.note: Release time and change point agree.

claims.text: Users report that the payment sheet closes when a saved card is selected.

causes.title: A paid social campaign may have ended

claims.text: No changelog entry or ticket in the date window mentions a campaign ending.
claims.note: Nothing to verify. Kept as a low confidence alternative.

CHG-0123.title: iOS app 5.14.0 - new payment sheet
CHG-0123.body: Released iOS 5.14.0 at 09:10 UTC. Replaces the payment sheet with the new SDK version. Rollout: 100% of iOS users.

ISS-0045.title: Payment sheet fails to open for saved cards on iOS 5.14.0
ISS-0045.body: After updating to 5.14.0 the payment sheet closes right away when a saved card is selected. Reproduced on iOS 17 and 18. Works on 5.13.2.

TKT-01234.title: Cannot pay with my saved card
TKT-01234.body: I tap Pay and the screen just closes. I tried three times on my iPhone. It worked last week.
